detectorConfig.arbitration: FIRST_DWELL; simultaneous -> integrated supra-threshold area; exact tie -> WAIT_CLEAR BOTH

baselines.note: Production uses a bounded 1s rolling collection ending at Neutral freeze; estimator reference is a different frozen 3s interval. No baseline is changed in production.

attribution.scope: Outcome sensitivity only. Fixed-baseline stream contrast includes pose availability, landmarks and sampling. No independent camera/model-cause experiment.
attribution.uncertainty: A same-stage temporal match is not the same camera frame. Subset removal is a sampling intervention, not a reproduction of LIVE sampling. Stream and sampling sensitivities overlap; they are not independent root causes. Negative clock/retiming controls do not rule out other timing effects. One capture cannot establish superiority or production replacement.

timing.subsetPolicy: Identical matched VIDEO frames/baseline, no clocks, only timestamps changed to matched LIVE times. Unmatched remain in alignment; this is not a full-stream parity claim.

alignment.unmatchedRecords: All original indices/timestamps retained in private divergence-report.json, including nonfinite/unmatched. No camera-frame identity assumption.

summaryPolicy: Derived aggregates only; complete diagnostics, signals and unmatched frame indices remain in the hashed private report. Raw landmark/video files are not copied into the repository.
